body:
Name: FantasticDerp
Reason for ban: Combat logging
Was the ban correct?: Yes, I just want it slightly shortened if possible and also have the false ban removed from my profile
Why it should be shortenerd: Well, delicious shoes HD banned me for combat logging when it should have been a temp ban, this happened on 8:55pm, so should be allowed back on at 8:55 PM today, but demur changed my ban to a temp ban on 11:55pm so technically I should be allowed back on at 8:55pm and not 11:55pm

Thanks for reading my appeal!
